name: Devopness
summary: DevOps platform that deploys apps and provisions cloud infrastructure in your own AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean or Hetzner account.
description: Cloud infrastructure and deployment platform replacing Terraform + Ansible + Jenkins + PaaS tools: provisions networks, servers and Linux config from scratch in your own cloud accounts, runs CI/CD with zero-downtime git deploys and role-based permissions. Managed from a web app, mobile, API or natural language through one MCP server that Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Zed and Warp can use.
contains: deploys to AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean and Hetzner
replaces Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, PaaS and per-stack server panels
MCP server for AI agents (Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Zed, Warp)
zero-downtime deploys triggered on git push
free plan, no credit card required
SDKs: @devopness/sdk-js (npm) and devopness (Python); @devopness/ui-react React design system
